_about: The looks a reel can be made in. Only styles in the rotation are picked automatically (rotation: false keeps a style available by hand, REEL_STYLE or the make.yml style input). With several in the rotation the maker never repeats the last reel's style. Founder, 12 Oct 2026: 'dont make the reels in same style... make some professional reels also'. Founder, 13 Oct 2026: reels must be conversational, two characters, for brand awareness, one a day: the duo style is the daily style; variety comes from the situations, sets and shots inside it.

styles.name: Maya & Floey
styles.research: The reel will be a short sitcom moment between Maya (a solo blogger who panics about her traffic) and Floey (Flowra's calm, dry hummingbird) in Maya's room: Maya at her desk with her laptop, Floey perched on the laptop, the mug or Maya's shoulder, a phone notification, a cutaway to her laptop screen (a chart drawing itself), number pills and comic marks. Propose a situation those parts can play: what Maya sees, what she fears, what Floey says, what Maya checks on screen, and how it turns out. No other characters on screen (others can text Maya). Cast guide: brand/cast/README.md.

styles.name: Floey's garden
styles.research: The reel will be animated in Floey's garden with a fixed set of parts; propose a visual idea those parts can tell: pages are flowers whose health rises or falls, bugs are errors Floey eats, the PAGE 1 line, tags, the review card, day counter, clicks chart. No new worlds or effects.

styles.name: Professional explainer
styles.research: The reel will be a clean, professional product explainer: a drawn working screen (Search Console, GA4, WordPress or Flowra itself) in motion: a chart drawing, rows sorting, a cursor clicking the exact control, the camera pushing in on the one row or number that matters, with a short headline above. Propose a visual idea that a real screen walkthrough can show step by step. No mascot, no metaphors.
